(1) **PASS** – The amber dashed border, darkened background, and distinct "WHAT-IF" icon/label clearly differentiate the hypothetical column from the photo-backed real listings.  
(2) **PASS** – Metric rows are strictly grid-aligned; the emerald highlights and crown icons on winning values (e.g., Asking price, $/sqft) are legible and correctly placed.  
(3) **PASS** – The verdict banner ("What-if added to sheet") is well-styled with clear iconography; overall polish (typography, spacing, color hierarchy) appears production-ready.  
(4) **FAIL (Minor)** – The "What-if" column header text ("What-if - $16...") and its sub-labels are visibly truncated/overflowing; the bottom tooltip also slightly overlaps the "Export CSV" button area.
